name: Augmentor
author: Manolo's DeepSeek Harness (preinstalled first-party add-on)
description: The ResonantOS Augmentor: Manolo's DeepSeek Harness, the product's one first-party agent. Proposes chat completions to a local DeepSeek-compatible (OpenAI) service through a simulated loopback. Preinstalled (first-party); capabilities are granted by the host at runtime.

tools.name: augmentor.status
tools.description: Read the local DeepSeek-compatible runtime health and availability.

tools.name: augmentor.run_task
tools.description: Run a delegated prompt through the local DeepSeek-compatible runtime and propose the completion (prepare/propose — a human approves the commit).
